summary: Frontend-only verification of docs-m6 (Line & Paragraph Spacing) instruction + tooltip clarity fix on /studio/docs/docs-m6. ALL FIXES VERIFIED: (1) Instruction panel now includes the 'How to change it' heading and the exact bullet 'In the toolbar, open the line-spacing menu — the small box that reads 1.0× (just right of the alignment buttons) — and choose 1.5×.' plus the Practice line 'Set both body lines to 1.5× spacing and bold the essay title.'. (2) The <select data-testid="studio-spacing"> now exposes title="Line spacing" as a browser tooltip. (3) End-to-end flow yields grade A: selecting b2 then setting studio-spacing to 1.5, selecting b3 then setting studio-spacing to 1.5 ticks studio-task-t1-done; selecting b1 then clicking studio-bold ticks studio-task-t2-done; studio-submit-btn -> studio-result-grade='A' with dialog 'Score 100% · 2/2 tasks · +100 · +1 Mark'. (4) Regression: docs-m1 and docs-m5 still load with full toolbar; studio-spacing tooltip present on docs-m1; changing spacing to '2' sets style.lineHeight=2 and to '1.15' sets 1.15 on the selected block.
critical_code_review_comments: Non-blocking (carried from iter_9/12): Hydration warning 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>' fires on any page that mounts DocEditorCore. The <option> children go through the preview instrumentation which wraps the text node in a <span data-ve-dynamic>. This is preview-tool injected, not product code, but it spams the console every mount — safe to ignore.

Non-blocking spec vs UI wording mismatch: review_request describes spacing options as '1×','1.15×','1.5×','2×' but the render uses `s.toFixed(2).replace(/0$/, '')` which produces '1.0×','1.15×','1.5×','2.0×'. This matches the instruction which references the '1.0×' box, so it is actually more consistent than the review_request. No fix needed — but flagging in case main agent expected '1×'/'2×'.
